title: The Trade-off between Performance, Efficiency, and Fairness in Adapter Modules for Text Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Equalized Odds (calculating the maximum difference between true positive and false positive rates) across religious identities in toxic text detection using the Jigsaw and HateXplain datasets.

Measuring Equalized Odds (calculating the maximum difference between true positive and false positive rates) across racial and ethnic identities in toxic text detection using the Jigsaw and HateXplain datasets.

Measuring Equalized Odds for gender and sexuality identities in toxic text detection tasks, and calculating the True Positive Rate (TPR) gap (root mean squared difference in TPRs between binary genders across occupations) in occupation classification using the BIOS dataset.
